## How was it tested?
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build`
- [ ] New or changed Plugin API calls are checked against `@figma/plugin-typings` and covered by the strict mock
- [ ] Tried in real Figma (describe), if the plugin changed

## Checklist
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under "Unreleased"
- [ ] Docs updated (README / docs/dsl.md / skill) if behaviour changed
